title: PrepMate
subtitle: AI interview prep
description: Practice a job interview out loud. It listens, adapts its questions to your resume or the job description, then scores your answers on relevance and clarity when you're done.

sections.heading: WHY THIS EXISTS
sections.content: My final-year project, built solo, end to end. I wanted mock interview practice that actually felt like a conversation — not a form you fill out after the fact.

sections.heading: THE HARD PART
sections.content: Knowing when someone actually stopped talking, not just paused. I replaced the browser's speech API with my own audio pipeline and used amplitude-based voice detection to catch silence reliably across different browsers, instead of guessing off a timer.

sections.heading: WHAT CHANGED IN MY HEAD
sections.content: Real-time systems can't wait on slow work. Scoring an answer takes time, so I moved it off the live conversation entirely and ran it in the background — the interview never stalls waiting on the AI to finish grading.

sections.heading: WORTH POINTING AT
bulletPoints: Full voice interview pipeline over WebSockets, with Groq for speech-to-text and text-to-speech
RMS-based voice activity detection for cross-browser silence detection
Adaptive question generation from a resume or job description
Post-interview scoring runs asynchronously so it never blocks the live conversation
